questiontext.text:
PAYE tax bands for resident individuals, from 1 July 2023 (Kenya Revenue Authority; Finance Act 2023):

Monthly taxable pay (Ksh)Rate
First \(24\,000\)\(10\%\)
Next \(8333\)\(25\%\)
Next \(467\,667\)\(30\%\)
Next \(300\,000\)\(32.5\%\)
Above \(800\,000\)\(35\%\)

Personal relief: Ksh \(2400\) a month, taken off the tax. PAYE is never negative.

For each monthly taxable pay, choose the highest rate at which any part of it is taxed.

(a) Ksh \({@ksh(pp[1])@}\) [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]

(b) Ksh \({@ksh(pp[2])@}\) [[input:ans2]] [[validation:ans2]] [[feedback:prt2]]

(c) Ksh \({@ksh(pp[3])@}\) [[input:ans3]] [[validation:ans3]] [[feedback:prt3]]

(d) Ksh \({@ksh(pp[4])@}\) [[input:ans4]] [[validation:ans4]] [[feedback:prt4]]

(e) Ksh \({@ksh(pp[5])@}\) [[input:ans5]] [[validation:ans5]] [[feedback:prt5]]

generalfeedback.text:
The band edges are \(24\,000\), \(32\,333\), \(500\,000\) and \(800\,000\). A pay exactly at the top of a band stays in that band.

  • (a) Ksh \({@ksh(pp[1])@}\): [[if test="is(S[1]=1)"]]All of it is in the first band, up to \(24\,000\).[[/if]][[if test="is(S[1]=2)"]]The first band ends at exactly \(24\,000\), so nothing is taxed above \(10\%\).[[/if]][[if test="is(S[1]=3)"]]\(500\) shillings are above \(24\,000\), in the \(25\%\) band.[[/if]][[if test="is(S[1]=4)"]]The \(25\%\) band runs up to \(24\,000 + 8333 = 32\,333\) exactly.[[/if]][[if test="is(S[1]=5)"]]\(67\) shillings are above \(32\,333\), in the \(30\%\) band.[[/if]][[if test="is(S[1]=6)"]]It is between \(32\,333\) and \(500\,000\): the top slice is taxed at \(30\%\).[[/if]][[if test="is(S[1]=7)"]]The \(30\%\) band runs up to \(500\,000\).[[/if]][[if test="is(S[1]=8)"]]The \(30\%\) band ends at exactly \(500\,000\).[[/if]][[if test="is(S[1]=9)"]]\(20\,000\) shillings are above \(500\,000\), in the \(32.5\%\) band.[[/if]][[if test="is(S[1]=10)"]]The \(32.5\%\) band ends at exactly \(800\,000\).[[/if]][[if test="is(S[1]=11)"]]Pay above \(800\,000\) is taxed at \(35\%\).[[/if]][[if test="is(S[1]=12)"]]Above \(800\,000\): \(35\%\) on the top slice.[[/if]][[if test="is(S[1]=13)"]]It is above \(24\,000\) but below \(32\,333\).[[/if]][[if test="is(S[1]=14)"]]Between \(32\,333\) and \(500\,000\): \(30\%\).[[/if]]

questiondescription.text:
Commercial Arithmetic III: highest tax band

Grade 12 CBE Essential 2.4 (e): Decide the highest PAYE rate that applies to each of five monthly taxable pays, including pays exactly at a band edge.

Essential

This question is original to this project.

INNODEMS CBC Grade 12 Mathematics, first draft by Ben Davies, 2026. Aligned to the KICD Senior School Curriculum Design, Essential Mathematics Grade 12 (draft).
